name: PREM
description: The Preliminary Reference Earth Model, prescribed as the elastic structure for GIAMIP experiments Exp01, Exp02, Exp05, Exp06 and Exp07. A viscosity profile such as VM5a or VM7 is layered onto it.

source.citation: Dziewonski, A. M. and Anderson, D. L. (1981). Preliminary reference Earth model. Physics of the Earth and Planetary Interiors 25(4), 297-356.

notes: The layer table is not reproduced here. PREM is widely distributed and every solver that needs it already carries a deck; sl1d ships three PREM variants in sl1d/models/.

The protocol states that each group may choose its own treatment of compressibility, so a PREM deck may be used compressible or with the incompressible approximation. The choice is recorded in the model report.
PREM is a seismic model and is layered in depth below the surface, while M3-L70-V01 is given in radius. Mixing the two conventions is a real risk when a single reader handles both.
